title: A new look for pollinations.ai
summary:
A pixel-art site redesign, API-key image generation in the playground, and steadier routing for legacy image models.

The site redesign adds responsive pixel-art scenes, a shared color palette, and updated typography across the home, apps, community, and playground pages. The home page now explains how it works, how to start free, and the available compute tiers.

Image generation in the playground can use a supplied API key. Changing keys now clears stale model-access information, while profile and balance requests use retries.

The legacy image service adds fixed backends for Sana 0.6B and Z-Image and re-registers them regularly, so image requests have targets that do not depend on GPU heartbeat registration.

highlights.title: A pixel-art pollinations.ai
highlights.text: Explore a redesigned site with responsive sky and ground scenes, a new color palette, and clearer ways to get started. [Visit pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).
